record.question: Which among the following need not be amended through special majority of Parliament and consent of the states?
options: Sixth Schedule - administration of tribal areas
Election of President and its manner
Any of the lists in the Seventh Schedule
record.explanation: Article 368's proviso lists the provisions needing ratification by half the states (including election of the President, Seventh Schedule lists, and representation of States in Parliament), but the Sixth Schedule is not on that list. So the Sixth Schedule can be amended by special majority alone.
